enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +35: Passive: +35 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.

Insightful Necromancy Focus +7: +7 Insight bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Blighted Lore +25: Passive: Your Acid, Negative, Poison and Evil spells gain a 25% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Blight +169: Passive: +169 Equipment bonus to Acid, Negative, Poison and Evil Spell Power.
Arcane Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by two.
